title: Platform Developer II
description: Advanced Apex, asynchronous processing, integration, Lightning UI, performance and testing.

questions.prompt: Which **two** capabilities does Queueable Apex have that `@future` methods do not? *(Choose 2)*

options.text: Accepting non-primitive types such as sObjects as job state

questions.explanation: Queueable jobs can hold complex state and enqueue a follow-up job, and `System.enqueueJob` returns a job Id to monitor. Both mechanisms can make callouts and both run asynchronously.

questions.prompt: What is the default number of records passed to each `execute` call of a Batch Apex job?
questions.explanation: The default scope is 200. With a `QueryLocator` you can pass up to 2,000 as the second argument to `Database.executeBatch`.

questions.prompt: A trigger must send record data to an external REST API. How should the callout be made?

options.text: From an asynchronous context, e.g. `@future(callout=true)` or a Queueable that implements `Database.AllowsCallouts`

questions.explanation: Synchronous callouts aren't allowed from triggers, because the transaction would hold database locks while waiting on the network. Move the callout to async Apex.

questions.prompt: Code inserts a `User` and an `Account` in the same transaction and fails with `MIXED_DML_OPERATION`. Which fix is valid?

options.text: Insert them in the opposite order
Perform one of the DML operations in a separate transaction, e.g. a `@future` method

questions.explanation: Setup objects (User, Group, PermissionSetAssignment…) and non-setup objects can't be modified in the same transaction. Split the work across transactions; in tests, `System.runAs` also separates them.

questions.prompt: Configuration records must move between orgs with the rest of a release through the Metadata API. Which feature fits?
questions.explanation: Custom metadata type **records** are metadata, so they deploy with packages and change sets. Custom settings data and custom object records are data and have to be loaded separately.

questions.prompt: A platform event must be published **only if** the publishing transaction commits. Which publish behavior should the event use?

options.text: Either — events always wait for commit
Neither; use a trigger on the event

questions.explanation: With **Publish After Commit**, the event is sent only if the transaction succeeds. **Publish Immediately** sends it even when the transaction later rolls back — useful for logging, but wrong for business events.

questions.prompt: How can a Queueable job reliably run clean-up or retry logic even when it fails with an uncatchable limit exception?

options.text: Chain a second Queueable at the end of `execute`

questions.explanation: A class implementing `System.Finalizer`, attached inside `execute`, runs after the job finishes, whether it succeeded or failed — including failures that `try/catch` and `finally` can't intercept.

questions.prompt: Which field is **not** indexed by default, and so may make a filter non-selective on a large object?

options.text: A custom text field that is not an External ID or unique

questions.explanation: Standard indexes cover `Id`, `Name`, `OwnerId`, `CreatedDate`, `SystemModstamp`, `RecordTypeId`, lookup and master-detail fields, plus custom fields marked External ID or unique. Other custom fields need a custom index.

questions.prompt: An LWC calls Apex that waits on a slow external service (around 60 seconds). Which approach avoids holding a synchronous Apex thread while waiting?
questions.explanation: Continuations make the callout asynchronously and resume Apex in a callback when the response arrives, so long waits don't count against the org's concurrent long-running request limit. A future method can't return a result to the UI.

questions.prompt: How do you test Apex that makes an HTTP callout?

options.text: Tests can make real callouts if the endpoint is in Remote Site Settings
Register a mock with `Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new MyMock())`
Callout code can't be covered by tests

questions.explanation: Real callouts are blocked in tests. An `HttpCalloutMock` implementation returns a fake response, which lets you test both success and error handling.

questions.prompt: How can a test verify behaviour for a user with a particular profile or permission set?

options.text: Use `SeeAllData=true` and query an existing user
Create the user in the test and wrap the code in `System.runAs(user)`

questions.explanation: `System.runAs` executes a block as the given user, enforcing record sharing for that user. It's only available in tests. (Field- and object-level security is enforced only where the code asks for it, e.g. `WITH USER_MODE`.)

questions.prompt: Where does `Test.loadData()` read its test records from?

options.text: A CSV file stored as a static resource
A JSON file in the test class

questions.explanation: `Test.loadData(Account.sObjectType, 'myResource')` inserts records from a CSV static resource. It's handy for large or reusable fixtures without writing them out in Apex.

questions.prompt: Code must update about 20 million records. Which approach stays within governor limits?

options.text: A Queueable that queries all records at once

questions.explanation: A QueryLocator lets a batch job process up to 50 million records, each `execute` getting a fresh set of limits. The other options query in one transaction and hit SOQL row or heap limits.

questions.prompt: An LWC must send a message to an Aura component and a Visualforce page on the same Lightning page, with no parent-child relationship. What should be used?
questions.explanation: Lightning Message Service communicates across the DOM between LWC, Aura and Visualforce on a Lightning page. DOM events only travel up the containment tree.

questions.prompt: An Apex method annotated `@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)` must also update a record. What happens?

options.text: It fails: cacheable methods can't perform DML
It works only when called imperatively

questions.explanation: Cacheable methods must not change data; DML in them throws an exception. Use a separate non-cacheable method, called imperatively.

questions.prompt: A component shows a list from `@wire(getContacts)` and updates one contact through an imperative Apex call. The list stays stale. What refreshes it?
questions.explanation: refreshApex(valueProvisionedByWire) re-runs the wired Apex call and replaces the cached data.

questions.prompt: Two components on one page show the same record with `getRecord`. One updates it with `updateRecord`. What happens to the other?

options.text: Nothing until the page is reloaded
It gets the new values automatically from the shared Lightning Data Service cache

questions.explanation: Lightning Data Service keeps one cache per record, so a change made through LDS is pushed to every component using that record.

questions.prompt: A Visualforce page must paginate through 10,000 Accounts 20 at a time. What's the simplest server-side approach?
questions.explanation: StandardSetController provides built-in pagination (next, previous, page size) over up to 10,000 records.

questions.prompt: What stops one Lightning web component from reading another namespace's component's DOM?
questions.explanation: Lightning Web Security, and Lightning Locker before it, isolates components by namespace so they can't reach into each other's DOM or globals.

questions.prompt: How do you create an instance of a class whose name is stored in custom metadata?
questions.explanation: Type.forName returns the class's type and newInstance creates an instance; cast it to an interface the class implements.

questions.prompt: An expensive calculation is reused by many users for an hour. Where can Apex keep the result?
questions.explanation: Platform Cache's org partition shares values across transactions and users until they expire; static variables last only one transaction.

questions.prompt: A method inserts an Order and its lines; if the lines fail, the Order must not remain. With partial DML elsewhere in the transaction, what helps?

options.text: A try/catch that ignores the error

questions.explanation: Savepoints let you undo DML back to a known point inside the transaction.

questions.prompt: Several payment providers need the same operations, chosen by configuration at runtime. What design fits?

options.text: One class with a big if/else
An interface implemented by each provider, created with Type.forName

questions.explanation: An interface plus dynamic instantiation is the strategy pattern: add a provider without changing callers.

questions.prompt: Apex managed sharing gives users access to a custom object's records. What must the share rows use so they aren't removed on recalculation?

options.text: RowCause set to a custom Apex sharing reason

questions.explanation: Shares with a custom Apex sharing reason survive owner changes; Manual shares are removed when the owner changes.

questions.prompt: What does a Transaction Finalizer attached to a Queueable job do?

options.text: Runs after the job finishes, even if it failed, so you can log or retry

questions.explanation: Finalizers run after the Queueable completes or fails, and can re-enqueue or record the outcome.

questions.prompt: A dynamic SOQL query must include a user-supplied search term. What's the safest approach?

options.text: Use a bind variable (:term) in Database.query or queryWithBinds

questions.explanation: Binds keep input as data; concatenation allows SOQL injection.

questions.prompt: Where should the endpoint URL and authentication for an external API live?

options.text: In a Named Credential (with an External Credential)

questions.explanation: Named Credentials keep endpoints and secrets out of code and handle authentication.

questions.prompt: A transaction performs DML and then a callout. What happens?

options.text: It fails with 'You have uncommitted work pending'
The DML is rolled back automatically

questions.explanation: Callouts can't follow uncommitted DML in the same transaction; do the callout first or move it to async Apex.

questions.prompt: How many callouts can one transaction make?
questions.explanation: The limit is 100 callouts per transaction, with a cumulative timeout of 120 seconds.

questions.prompt: Which annotation exposes an Apex method for HTTP POST in a custom REST service?
questions.explanation: The class has @RestResource(urlMapping=...); each method uses @HttpGet, @HttpPost and so on.

questions.prompt: What's the safest way to parse a known JSON response?

options.text: JSON.deserialize(body, MyResponse.class) into a typed class

questions.explanation: Typed deserialisation gives compile-time field names and types.

questions.prompt: Admins want to call a REST API from Flow without Apex. What enables that?

options.text: External Services, registered from an OpenAPI specification

questions.explanation: External Services generate invocable actions from an API's OpenAPI spec.

questions.prompt: An external system must receive every change to Opportunities in near real time without polling. What fits?

options.text: A workflow outbound message per field

questions.explanation: Change Data Capture publishes create, update, delete and undelete events that subscribers receive.

questions.prompt: An integration loads 3 million records nightly. Which API?

options.text: REST API, one call per record
SOAP API, one call per record

questions.explanation: Bulk API processes large data sets asynchronously in batches.

questions.prompt: Which can make a callout when a record is inserted?

options.text: A Queueable implementing Database.AllowsCallouts, enqueued from the trigger

questions.explanation: Triggers can't call out synchronously; async Apex can.

questions.prompt: An external system retries failed requests, and retries sometimes create duplicate Orders. What design prevents duplicates?

options.text: Send the system's own order number and upsert on an External ID field
Use a validation rule on Name

questions.explanation: Upserting on an External ID makes the operation idempotent: a retry updates the existing record instead of creating another.

questions.prompt: A server-to-server integration must log in to Salesforce with no user present, using a certificate. Which OAuth flow?
questions.explanation: The JWT bearer flow signs a token with a certificate; no interactive login is needed.

questions.prompt: Which can subscribe to a Lightning Message Service channel on the same page? Choose 2.
questions.explanation: LMS works across LWC, Aura and Visualforce on a Lightning page; server-side code isn't a subscriber.

questions.prompt: Which hook lets a parent component catch errors thrown by its children?
questions.explanation: errorCallback(error, stack) acts like an error boundary for the component's children.

questions.prompt: A component re-renders slowly because a getter loops over thousands of rows. What helps most?

options.text: Compute the result once when the data changes and store it in a field

questions.explanation: Getters run on every render; caching derived data avoids repeated work.

questions.prompt: A Visualforce page fails with a view state size error. What reduces view state?
questions.explanation: transient variables aren't stored in view state.

questions.prompt: How should a component display HTML-formatted text from a record safely?
questions.explanation: lightning-formatted-rich-text sanitises the HTML before rendering it.

questions.prompt: In Jest tests, how do you give a wired Apex method data?

options.text: Use the test wire adapter's emit() with mock data

questions.explanation: Wire adapters are mocked in Jest; emit() pushes data into the component.

questions.prompt: A test inserts a User and an Account and fails with MIXED_DML_OPERATION. What fixes it?
questions.explanation: Setup objects (User) and non-setup objects can't mix in one transaction; runAs separates them in tests.

questions.prompt: How can a test set an old CreatedDate on a test record?
questions.explanation: Test.setCreatedDate lets tests set the CreatedDate of records they inserted.

questions.prompt: Which feature replaces a class's behaviour with a mock in unit tests without changing production code?
questions.explanation: The Stub API creates mock implementations via Test.createStub.

questions.prompt: Which loads test records from a CSV static resource?
questions.explanation: Test.loadData inserts records from a static resource CSV and returns them.

questions.prompt: How do you make a batch job run inside a test?

options.text: Call Database.executeBatch between Test.startTest and Test.stopTest

questions.explanation: Async jobs started inside start/stopTest run synchronously at stopTest; only one execute call is tested per test.

questions.prompt: In a test, when are published platform events delivered to subscribers?
questions.explanation: Test event delivery happens at stopTest or when you call Test.getEventBus().deliver().

questions.prompt: A test must check that a method uses at most one query. What can it read?
questions.explanation: The Limits class reports usage so far in the transaction.

questions.prompt: Which tool lets you step through a recorded debug log with breakpoints in VS Code?
questions.explanation: Apex Replay Debugger replays a debug log in VS Code with breakpoints and variable inspection.

questions.prompt: A method makes two callouts to different endpoints. How does a test return different responses?

options.text: One HttpCalloutMock that checks req.getEndpoint() and responds accordingly

questions.explanation: A single mock can branch on the request's endpoint or method; MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock is another option.

questions.prompt: Which filter is most likely selective on an object with millions of records?
questions.explanation: External ID fields are indexed; equality filters on indexed fields are selective. Leading wildcards and negative filters aren't.

questions.prompt: Large reports on an object are slow even with selective filters. Which can Salesforce Support enable to help?
questions.explanation: Skinny tables hold frequently used fields together to avoid joins, and are enabled by Salesforce Support.

questions.prompt: One integration user owns 2 million Accounts and sharing changes are slow. What is this?
questions.explanation: Ownership skew (very many records owned by one user) makes sharing recalculation slow; spread ownership or use a user outside the role hierarchy.

questions.prompt: Code hits the heap limit processing a large query. What helps most?

options.text: A SOQL for loop or Batch Apex to process in chunks
Using a Set instead of a List

questions.explanation: Processing in chunks keeps only part of the data in memory at a time.

questions.prompt: Which change reduces CPU time in a trigger processing 200 records?

options.text: Replacing nested loops with a Map lookup

questions.explanation: Nested loops are O(n²); a map turns lookups into constant time.

questions.prompt: A Lightning page loads many related lists users rarely open. What improves load time?

options.text: Load the data only when the user opens the section (lazy loading)

questions.explanation: Deferring rarely used data keeps the first render fast.

questions.prompt: Which tool shows whether a SOQL query would use an index and its relative cost?

options.text: Query Plan tool in the Developer Console

questions.explanation: The Query Plan tool shows the plans the optimiser considers, with cost and whether an index is used.

questions.prompt: Which is higher for asynchronous Apex than synchronous? Choose 2.
questions.explanation: Async gets 200 queries and 12 MB heap (and 60 s CPU); DML statements (150) and callouts (100) are the same.
